## Block Markup

This is a [**hybrid block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:cover {"useFeaturedImage":false,"alt":"","hasParallax":false,"isRepeated":false,"dimRatio":100,"backgroundType":"image","isDark":true,"tagName":"div"} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:cover -->
```
